customize.name: Windows10Language-1-InstallLanguage
inline: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $u='<immutable-install-language-wrapper-uri>'; $p=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'InstallLanguagePacks.ps1'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -OutFile $p -UseBasicParsing; if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '<install-language-wrapper-sha256>'){throw 'InstallLanguagePacks.ps1 checksum mismatch.'}; & $p -LanguageList @('French (France)'); if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}

customize.name: Windows10Language-5-ApplyMachineLanguage
inline: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $u='<immutable-apply-language-wrapper-uri>'; $p=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'SetDefaultLang.ps1'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -OutFile $p -UseBasicParsing; if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '<apply-language-wrapper-sha256>'){throw 'SetDefaultLang.ps1 checksum mismatch.'}; & $p -Language 'French (France)'; if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
